# CompuMaster.Dms 2026.10.16.0

## CompuMaster.Dms.Providers

- Adopt the published CompuMaster.Scopevisio.OpenApi 2026.10.16 package, including its compatible explicit-organisation authorization, current request/result APIs, native cancellation improvements and additional account metadata.
- Preserve the existing CenterDevice.Rest 2026.10.13, Scopevisio.Teamwork 2026.10.13 and Ocs 2026.10.12 dependencies. No public DMS API or default provider selection changes are introduced by this update.

## CompuMaster.Dms.BrowserUI

- Consume the updated provider dependency while retaining existing login and browser behavior.

## Repository infrastructure

- Add a manual package-integration workflow that builds the solution and demos, runs full isolated Windows/net8 provider and BrowserUI tests, and retains the existing named samples on other platforms/frameworks. It uses published packages and does not load test-account secrets or run remote-server tests. Existing account workflows and locks are unchanged.

## Known limitations

- Actual Scopevisio Teamwork Demo access remains tracked in DMS #137. This package update does not claim to resolve its authentication failure.
- OpenScope investigations #239 (statistics-unit HTTP 403) and #240 (an earlier contact creation without acknowledgement), and optional broader acceptance work #241, remain separate.
- The unpublished fixture migration in DMS #135 is excluded from this release.
